task_definition.task_description: Please check whether my checking account is active, then get the USD to EUR exchange rate, check whether NASDAQ is open, assess the risk for a $2500 trade, and if it’s allowed place a buy order at 125.5. After that, get the current weather alert for Paris and send it to me in the app, then book a standard room at Hilton Tokyo for Alice Johnson from 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-14, get the hotel stay details for Hilton Tokyo and email them to me, and finally create a document called “Travel funding and booking summary” with “Hilton Tokyo Available at 180 USD/night” and alert me in the app.
